messages.text:
A few things broke in the game, and I'd like them all fixed:

1. The best score acts strangely. A worse game can replace it, and a size I've never finished shows 0.
2. I can't move between the cards with the arrow keys anymore.
3. I turned on reduced motion on my computer, but the cards and the win banner still animate.
4. The game started beeping when I find a pair.

Keep the rest working, and please follow the project rules.

Fixed all four issues:

- Best moves now update only when a score improves, and sizes without a finished game show `none` instead of `0` in [storage.ts](/work/src/game/session/storage.ts:61) and [GameStatus.tsx](/work/src/game/status/GameStatus.tsx:30).
- Arrow keys move focus between cards and stop at board edges in [use-board-focus.ts](/work/src/game/board/use-board-focus.ts:28).
- Reduced motion disables card transitions and the win animation in [card.css](/work/src/game/board/card.css:49) and [status.css](/work/src/game/status/status.css:38).
- Removed the pair and win chimes from [use-game.ts](/work/src/game/session/use-game.ts:77).

`git diff --check` passed. I did not run the test suite.
